Changes for ZLN Terminal by Zaw Lin Naing:
- Coordinate normalization and web-scene scale.
- SWISS-inspired red-and-white livery and projected lettering/crosses.
- Animated fan groups and additional retractable landing gear.
- Integration with the portfolio landing and takeoff sequences.
- Replacement horizontal tailplanes with thinner, tapered airfoil surfaces.

The model creator does not endorse this adaptation.
The SWISS name and livery identify the requested aircraft inspiration.
Full base-asset license: aircraft-license.txt

Boeing 777-300ER interpretation
Original procedural geometry created for ZLN Terminal by Zaw Lin Naing.
Proportions reference Boeing and SWISS published length (73.9 m) and span (64.8 m).
https://www.boeing.com/commercial/777
https://www.swiss.com/xk/en/discover/fleet/boeing
This is a lightweight artistic interpretation, not an engineering or flight-training model.

Airport and landscape
Original Dock E-inspired layout, procedural surface textures and Swiss mountain scenery.
Architectural reference: exposed concrete, metal structures, terrazzo and glass facades.
https://www.flughafen-zuerich.ch/en/company/flughafen-zuerich/airport-development/old-conctruction-projects/dock-e
